name: softube-ts-bus-glue
description: Gentle whole-kit lift on a drum bus via the Softube Transient Shaper — the manual's drum-bus recipe: just a tiny bit of HIGH-band PUNCH (crossover 2-4 kHz) so the kit reads a touch more present/cohesive without changing the low end. Restrained by design (bus-level affects everything uniformly).
intended_for: a finished drum bus that wants a small cohesive presence/attack lift — NOT heavy shaping (use per-stem for surgical moves)
plugin_build: Softube 'Transient Shaper.vst3' (renders headless via Pedalboard; iLok-authorized — re-verify on a new machine)
notes: Manual: Punch 1-4 dB / HIGH / crossover 2-4 kHz on the bus. Keep it small — bus transient shaping hits every drum and over-processing pumps. SLOW for smooth presence, FAST for more snap. Expect a small crest/PLR + HF lift; A/B loudness-matched.
